name: Cape Town
industries: Technology, e-commerce and offshore delivery for European clients lead, alongside insurance and asset management.
intro:
Cape Town's project market has a different accent from Johannesburg's: this is South Africa's technology and e-commerce capital, home to the retailers, insurers and fintechs that built the country's digital economy, plus a thriving offshoring scene delivering for UK and European clients in a friendly timezone. Scrum credentials are especially valued in the tech cluster from Woodstock to Century City, while PMP anchors the asset-management and insurance programme world. Batches are scheduled live online across the whole year at hours built for Cape Town: a weekend Sat–Sun cohort and a weekday Wed–Thu cohort each week, all landing in comfortable local daytime; every upcoming date and its exact Cape Town timing is listed in the schedule below. Afterwards we guide your exam application, run mock exams calibrated to the real paper, and keep the trainer reachable for questions until you pass.

Cape Town pairs Africa's strongest tech-and-services cluster with the retail and insurance head offices that never left: product companies and global capability centres hire delivery leads for international clients, while the corporates run their own change portfolios. Both streams read certification as proof of transferable method — especially valuable in a city selling remote-friendly talent to the world. The course runs live online across two consecutive days in South African hours, from wherever on the peninsula you work. Cape Town salaries differ from Johannesburg's in shape as well as size; the sourced entries below give this market's own numbers. The employer list shows the tech-retail-insurance mix hiring certified professionals, and delivery centres can certify team leads together via private cohorts.

faq.q: What are the class timings in Cape Town?
faq.a: Live classes run 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM UK, which is 10:00 AM – 07:00 PM SAST in Cape Town. You can pick a weekend (Sat–Sun) or a weekday (Wed–Thu) cohort; each completes the course over two consecutive days.

faq.q: Is the training online or at a venue in Cape Town?
faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Cape Town. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.

faq.q: Is the certificate different if I attend from South Africa?
faq.a: No. The certification is issued by the same global body regardless of where you attend from, and holds identical recognition with employers in South Africa and internationally.

faq.q: Can my employer in Cape Town sponsor the course?
faq.a: Yes. We issue invoices suitable for corporate sponsorship and reimbursement, and most employers in South Africa accept them under learning and development budgets. Group pricing is available for teams.

faq.q: How much does {course} training cost in Cape Town?
faq.a: The fee for the live online {course} course for Cape Town is shown at the top of this page in ZAR and covers the complete two-day program. The displayed amount is the complete training fee, with no hidden extras.

faq.q: Should I pick the weekday or weekend {course} batch in Cape Town?
faq.a: Identical {course} syllabus either way — choose whichever pair of days your Cape Town schedule can spare. The batch table above shows every session converted to Cape Town local time.

faq.q: Can I take the {course} exam from Cape Town?
faq.a: Yes — the {course} exam can be taken online from Cape Town; you do not need to travel. The exam and certification guide further up this page explains the exact format, attempts and booking process.

faq.q: Is {course} certification recognized by employers in Cape Town?
faq.a: Yes. The {course} credential is issued by its global certifying body and is the one most commonly named in relevant Cape Town job descriptions. The employer list on this page shows where certified professionals in Cape Town work.

faq.q: What salary can a {course}-certified professional expect in Cape Town?
faq.a: See the salary table on this page — every Cape Town figure carries a named source and an as-of date, so you can verify it rather than trust a marketing average. Certified professionals typically use these sourced numbers in appraisal and offer negotiations.

faq.q: How soon can I start {course} training in Cape Town?
faq.a: The batch table above lists the next start dates for Cape Town — two cohorts run every week (weekday and weekend), so you are never more than a few days from a {course} start.

faq.q: Do you offer group pricing for {course} training for teams in Cape Town?
faq.a: Yes. Teams in Cape Town can enroll together under group pricing, and larger groups can run a private {course} cohort scheduled to their own calendar — use the enquiry option on this page with your team size.

faq.q: What language is the {course} training in Cape Town delivered in?
faq.a: All live {course} sessions are delivered in English, the working language of certification exams and of most project teams in Cape Town. Trainers take questions throughout the live sessions.

faq.q: How do I enroll in the {course} course from Cape Town?
faq.a: Pick a batch from the table above and use its Enroll button — you'll get a confirmation by email. The full flow is online; nothing requires visiting an office in Cape Town.

faq.q: Where can I see the {course} exam fee for South Africa?
faq.a: The exam-cost section on this page lists the current {course} exam fee for South Africa with a link to the certifying body's official fee page, so the number you plan around is the official one.

faq.q: Why choose live online {course} training over a self-paced course in Cape Town?
faq.a: Live {course} classes include exercises, discussion and instant answers — the parts that make the material stick — and the two-day schedule means Cape Town learners are done, not perpetually 40% through a playlist.
